lines.text: Josiah read the Book of the Covenant to all the people and made a covenant by the pillar.
Josiah had Hilkiah remove the articles for Baal and Asherah and burn them in the fields of Sharon.
Josiah desecrated Topheth so no one could sacrifice a child to Molech, and burned the chariots of the sun.
Josiah pulled down Manasseh's altars and desecrated high places King Saul built for Ashtoreth, Chemosh and Milcom.
Josiah burned bones from the tombs at Bethel on the altar, but left the man of God's bones undisturbed.
